title: Threats on Mount Rushmore in the security briefing
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mount Rushmore, South Dakota

tellings.quote: You know, there were threats on Mount Rushmore and they wanted to detonate a site

plain: In 1977, a security briefing at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota warned of threats against Mount Rushmore, with someone wanting to blow up a site. Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he and fellow airmen were later taken by aliens, remembers the briefing himself. He tells it as part of setting the scene of what the base's security men were on guard against that year.
